blocks.title: Software development methodologies
blocks.text: Software development methodologies are structured approaches to software development that guide the planning, creation and management of software projects. They help make the development process systematic and efficient and produce high-quality software.
The methodologies covered in this chapter are the Waterfall model, Agile methodology, Scrum, Lean software development and DevOps. Each suits some kinds of project better than others.
